sentences.text: If you dig a deep hole in the yard and fill it with water, you have a pool.
But the ground drinks it, and a hole holding 20,000 gallons will drain empty into the soil.
So you spray a concrete shell onto the floor and walls, and the water stays.
But now leaves and dirt fall in, and the still water turns green.
So you add a pump, a pipe to carry the water, and a tank of sand.
The pump pulls water from the floor, the sand traps the dirt, and clean water flows back.
And the strong chlorine smell is not a sign of a clean pool.
It is chlorine bonded with sweat, urine and oils, so a truly clean pool barely smells.
Add a fence, bushes and young trees to finish the pool and keep it safe.
Congratulations, you have built a swimming pool.
